title: The Middle-Aged Lover
subtitle: A Story
setting: Brickford, an English manufacturing town, and London
summary: Written by the Irish-born novelist, biographer, and Dickens associate Percy Fitzgerald (1834–1925), this two-volume story is set in the English manufacturing town of Brickford during the late nineteenth century. Its central plot turns on a rivalry over Corinna Nagle, the musically gifted daughter of an ambitious local singing-master, courted both by the wealthy middle-aged bachelor Mr. Doughty and by the young officer Alfred Duke, amid the schemes of the Gardiners, Lady Duke, and Dr. Spooner. First published in 1873, the two volumes are combined here into a single digital edition.
